exceptions.reason: FullCalendar's own CSS and the Monarch palette load with the calendar's lazy chunk only, so sign-in and the other pages don't pay for its 5.4 kB gzipped.

A calendar's colour and a palette swatch's arrive from data as the inline --calendar-color and --swatch properties (EventForm, DetailsPopover, SearchResults, DayList, ColorPicker, CalendarRow); utilities read them with bg-(color:--calendar-color). It is data, not a design colour.
The calendar feed answers text/calendar as a string, which skips the serializer, so the route declares its params and no response schema (Q53).
